title: Content Strategist & Creator
description:
XANDRO Lab is building Biocap — a new product category for people who take their biology seriously. We make precision longevity protocols backed by clinical science. We are growing fast and this role exists to build the content engine that takes us from known to essential.




The Role

This is a hands-on, full-spectrum content role.
You will own content strategy and execution across every marketing channel — social, email, long-form, video, paid creative, and community.
You are not writing briefs for an agency. You are creating the work.
You will work directly with an experienced marketing lead and have direct access to the Co-founder & CEO.
You will be supported by an expert copywriter, a graphic designer, and a videographer/photographer. The creative vision, the editorial calendar, the content experiments — those are yours to run.




What you will do

Content Strategy Own the editorial calendar across all channels. Define content pillars aligned to our brand positioning. Plan campaigns that convert audiences into buyers.
Social Media Run our Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn presence. Script and shoot short-form video. Build a content rhythm that grows community and drives traffic.
(optional) Long-Form & SEO Translate complex science into content that ranks and converts. Ingredient explainers, protocols, comparison articles, and perspective pieces.
Support Paid Creative Script and produce ad creative for Meta. Conceptualise hooks, test formats, and feed the performance team with content that earns attention.
Creator & Affiliate Brief and coordinate our creator network. Ensure output is on-brand and on-time. Identify new collaboration opportunities.




What you work with

We provide everything you need to do the job well.

Full AI tool stack — licensed and ready to use
In-house photo studio
Dedicated videographer and photographer
Expert copywriter for high-stakes copy
Graphic designer for creative production
Established creator and affiliate network




This is not a traditional role

You will have flexibility on where you work. You are expected in the office when it matters — shoots, team days, launch moments — but this is not a desk-by-9am arrangement.
You will help grow this company 2x over the next few months. That means a lot of experimentation, a lot of iteration, and a lot of hustle.
We move fast. We test things. We are not building a content departments.
If you are someone who thrives on creative ownership and wants to understand from the inside how an online business scales 10x to 100x — this is that opportunity.




Who you are

You have created content for a DTC or consumer brand, not just managed it
You can write well and you know when to let visuals do the work
You understand the science-to-story translation problem and enjoy solving it
You are comfortable with data — you check what worked and why
You think in campaigns, not individual posts
You are curious about longevity, performance, and human biology
You have a point of view on what good content looks like and you defend it
You can hold multiple channels at once without dropping quality




Why join

This is a growth role at a company with real science, real products, and real revenue. You will work closely with the founding team, have genuine ownership over a major function, and learn how online businesses are built from the inside.

title: Content Strategist
description:
We are looking for a creative-first individual to help us explore the boundaries of AI-assisted storytelling. You will work closely with our product team to define the creative standards for the next generation of digital media.

Job description: Content Creation (60%)

● Conceptualize: Design compelling story arcs, character identities, and thematic structures for digital media.

● Direct AI Models: Craft high-level creative directives to guide generative models toward specific artistic styles, tones, and moods.

● Content Assembly: Produce polished, media segments (1–3 minutes) by curating and synthesizing various created components.

● Creative Iteration: Refine outputs through precise stylistic adjustments, focusing on pacing, aesthetic "feel," and the selection of the best possible takes.

Quality Evaluation (25%)

● Rate AI-generated content against human-produced benchmarks on: emotional impact, visual coherence, voice naturalness, pacing, narrative hook strength

● Identify failure modes: uncanny valley moments, continuity breaks, dialogue that feels off, visual artifacts

● Maintain a quality log documenting what works, what doesn't, and patterns in output quality

● Participate in blind A/B evaluations comparing contents from difference sources

Tool Feedback (15%)

● Document friction points, bugs, and workflow bottlenecks

● Suggest new features or adjustments

● Help define what "good enough" looks like for AI-generated content

● Share stylistic techniques and "prompting" shortcuts with the broader creative community
